summary: Lando Norris secured McLaren's first victory of the season at Hungary, managing tire degradation to hold off late-race pressure and cross the line ahead of his nearest challenger. The race featured intense qualifying drama that set up a tense battle through the afternoon, with drivers struggling to manage compound wear on the Hungaroring's abrasive surface. The win closes Norris's gap in the championship standings and signals McLaren's resurgence in the constructor's battle.
